case.description: floating hemisphere, heave, deep water, zero forward speed; radiation memory kernel of the Cummins equation
case.reference: Hulme (1982) J. Fluid Mech. 121:443-463 semi-analytical radiation coefficients via tensorbem.analytic.hulme_hemisphere_radiation

parity_closure.note: the kernel rebuilt from the even/odd spectrum pair [B cos - omega (A - A_inf) sin] / pi must equal the cosine transform of B alone; the residual is normalised by the kernel peak because the odd partner decays like 1/omega and its band truncation converges only conditionally
